body.name: sehats
body.def: \(\widehat{\operatorname{se}}_s^2\) is the sum of the Bartlett HAC variance of fitted \(\psi_{s,t}\) on \(\mathcal B_n\), divided by \(|\mathcal B_n|\), and the Bartlett HAC variance of fitted \(v_{s,t}\) on \(\mathcal C_n\), divided by \(m\), both using bandwidth \(h_n\)
